rubric_items.reason: All paths of the changed count line have tests: the total-vs-page count (REQ-1/REQ-5), singular, zero with the empty message kept (REQ-3/REQ-4), the search change (REQ-2, the gap from attempt 1) and the error branch.

The assertions check text the user sees. The REQ-5 test now also checks that '2 patients' is absent. The REQ-2 test checks that '12 patients' goes away after the change. The error test checks that the error text shows and that no count matches /^\d+ patients?$/.
The zero, singular, failed-request (500) and search-change cases are covered. The loading state, where the count line should be absent, is not asserted.

The tests use Vitest and Testing Library in the existing web test file, as the strategy says. The new test names still start with run-local REQ-n IDs instead of PRD IDs (F-2 from attempt 1 is still open).

The artifact gives no numbers of its own and leaves test and coverage results to the verifier. checks.json shows test passed and coverage skipped (exit 78), which matches the gap the strategy records.

findings.text: Still open from attempt 1 (F-2): the new test names start with run-local REQ-n IDs. The strategy wants each name to start with its PRD requirement ID, and the HMS-2 tests in the same file follow that rule.

cites.quote: Every PRD requirement has at least one test whose name starts with its ID (DOC-1, APT-4, ...).
it('REQ-2: the count follows a change of the search text'

findings.suggested_fix: Rename the tests to start with the PRD ID given to LIVE-1 once the product owner sets it.

findings.text: The REQ-2 and failed-request tests repeat the fetch-stub and MemoryRouter render code by hand instead of using a shared helper. This is duplicate setup code.
findings.suggested_fix: Split renderWith into a helper that takes a fetch mock, and use it in all five tests.

findings.text: The resolves list names only F-1. The tests now also address attempt-1 F-3 (the '2 patients' absence check) and F-4 (the failed-request test), but the frontmatter does not record either.
findings.suggested_fix: Add resolves entries for F-3 and F-4.

cites.quote: PatientsPage (design component, changed) now shows a count line above the patient table

questions.text: Which PRD requirement ID (for example a new HMS-n) should the LIVE-1 test names start with, as the test strategy requires?
